svg.text: Two wobbles make a bigger wobble
Example 1 (two teachers): each class mean has its own chance error, and their difference carries both.
1. Each sample mean wobbles on its own
2. If H0 is true, the difference wobbles around 0
Bigger than either SE alone, but smaller than 0.62 + 0.49 = 1.11. Variances add, standard errors do not.
